description: Machine-readable map from Fortlet Improvement Proposals to implementation evidence. Conformant entries require tests; partial entries require gaps; update this file with the code that changes conformance.

entries.title: Project-scoped capsule architecture
gaps: Harness adapters do not yet own persistent paths or credential policy.

Deterministic CLI evidence covers actionable failures through local environment-layer validation; live MicroSandbox capsule reconciliation and terminal attachment failure evidence remains outstanding.
Automated coverage does not yet exercise capsule topology and concurrency or terminal semantics.
Status, stop, restart, logs, and tool-update management commands are not implemented.
Interactive and background workload leases are not yet represented explicitly.
Declarative project environment activation and private overlays are not implemented.
The host-side publication transaction is not implemented.
A supported standalone installation path that does not require Nix is not implemented.
Native x86_64-linux package verification is outstanding.

entries.title: Optional transparent harness shims
gaps: Runner evidence proves both packaged shims attach through real PTYs, produce activity after resize, share the expected capsule with concurrent invocations, and remain responsive. Native controls show both Tact and externally launched Codex remain alive after their first foreground-group SIGINT. Native and packaged Codex also both remained alive after atomic `/exit\r`, paced `/exit`, and one `0x03` PTY key under the bounded observer. These matching timeouts expose no Fortlet-specific discrepancy. Manual native evidence confirms one Ctrl-C exits at an idle empty composer, but automated native idle readiness, exact eventual termination, and packaged exit-status preservation remain unresolved.
